jobs.title: Principal Product Marketing Manager - AI Innovation
jobs.description:
Iterable is the AI customer engagement platform, built for enterprise scale, loved by teams, and trusted by global brands like Redfin, SeatGeek, Priceline, Calm, and Box. Our platform empowers organizations to activate customer data from any source, design seamless cross-channel experiences, and optimize engagement with Nova Intelligence, the AI layer of our platform, all with enterprise-grade security and compliance. Today, nearly 1,200 brands across 50+ countries rely on Iterable to drive growth, deepen customer relationships, and deliver joyful customer experiences.



Our success is powered by extraordinary people who bring our core values to life every day: Be an Owner, Growth Mindset, Run as One, and Transparency. And the market has noticed: G2 recognizes Iterable as a Leader globally, spanning the Americas, EMEA, APAC, ANZ, and Latin America, with category leadership in Personalization, Marketing Automation, Push Notifications, and Mobile Marketing, and a 4.5/5-star rating from hundreds of users. Gartner named Iterable a Challenger in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Multichannel Marketing in both 2024 and 2025. We’ve also earned TrustRadius Top Rated honors in 2024 and 2025, were named a TrustRadius Buyer’s Choice for 2026, and were featured in Snowflake’s Modern Marketing Data Stack 2026.



With a global presence that includes offices in San Francisco, Denver, London, Sydney, and Lisbon, plus remote employees worldwide, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and encourage you to apply. Learn more about our story and mission on our Culture https://iterable.com/culture/ and About Us https://iterable.com/company/ pages. Let’s shape the future of customer engagement together!




THE ROLE:

As Principal PMM, you'll own the overarching AI and Orchestration Innovation narrative for Iterable, connecting individual capabilities into a single, compelling point of view on where AI-driven customer engagement is headed and why Iterable wins.

You'll drive Iterable's Tier 1 launches, our flagship releases that establish category leadership, earn analyst and press attention, and give the go-to-market org a unifying story to sell against. Key Responsibilities

Own the AI Narrative

 - Define and evolve Iterable's overarching AI point of view, which is the connective story that links individual capabilities into a coherent AI story and why we win there.

 - Translate deep technical understanding of how our AI actually works (models, agentic workflows, data/orchestration architecture) into customer value that resonates with both practitioners and executives.

Craft Messaging

 - Craft bold, narrative-driven messaging and positioning that connects AI and orchestration innovation to tangible customer value.

 - Write the Tier 1 launch messaging for flagship AI releases, setting the story every other asset needs to ladder back to.

 - Review and give direction on launch content and campaigns across the team, ensuring every asset ladders back to the launch narrative rather than drifting into its own

Market Intelligence

 - Conduct ongoing research into AI market trends, competitive positioning, and customer needs to sharpen and stress-test Iterable's AI point of view

 - Partner with product management to ensure the AI narrative reflects real market shifts and informs roadmap decisions

Adoption & Customer Success

 - Drive customer adoption and expansion of AI capabilities through lifecycle messaging and targeted enablement

 - Partner with customer marketing and CS on reference stories and case studies that prove out the AI narrative with real customers


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

 - 8–10+ years in product marketing at a B2B SaaS company, including ownership of Tier 1 bundled product releases. Prior martech experience is a plus.

 - Experience marketing an AI-native or agentic product, or a platform transitioning from feature-based to AI-managed experiences

 - Exceptional storytelling: a track record of shaping the strategic "why" behind a launch and translating it into messaging that sells

 - Deep, genuine understanding of how AI works, including models, agentic systems, and data architecture, with the ability to translate that into clear, differentiated customer narratives

 - A genuinely AI-forward PMM who is redefining what product marketing looks like by using AI tools in creative, non-obvious ways across research, messaging, and content development

 - Executive presence: comfortable operating as a strategic peer to senior Product and GTM leaders, with sound independent judgment and limited need for oversight


SUCCESS METRICS:

 - Market awareness, pipeline, and revenue influence across Tier 1 release launches 

 - Adoption and expansion of AI capabilities across the customer base

 - Executive and analyst recognition of Iterable's AI point of view

Perks & Benefits: 

 - Paid parental leave

 - Competitive salaries, meaningful equity, & 401(k) plan

 - Medical, dental, vision, & life insurance

 - Community Impact Days

 - Fertility & Adoption Assistance

 - Paid Sabbatical

 - Flexible PTO

 - Monthly Employee Wellness allowance 

 - Monthly Professional Development allowance 

 - Pre-tax commuter benefits

 - Complete laptop workstation

$172,000 - $230,000 is the US base salary range for this position. Within this range, individual pay is determined by the specific US work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, relevant education or training, and internal equity considerations. Please note that the range listed reflects only base salary. The total compensation package includes variable pay (where applicable), equity, and a range of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, and financial.

ABOUT THE ROLE AND TEAM:

Iterable is building the next generation of customer engagement, one where AI doesn’t just assist, it acts. Our platform is evolving into an AI-native system powered by Nova, enabling teams to translate goals into intelligent, real-time customer experiences across every channel. Over time, marketers won't just work inside Iterable. They will orchestrate campaigns directly through their preferred AI tools, whether that’s ChatGPT, Claude, an in-house agent, or a CLI.

 

As Product Manager for External AI Tools, you will define how Nova shows up in external AI tools. You will work directly with a dedicated engineering team based in Lisbon building the connectors, packaging, and experiences that make Nova usable wherever marketers work. In this role, you'll report to the Senior Director of Product, Nova.

One of our core values is a growth mindset, and Iterable is a company where everyone can grow. If this role excites you, please apply. We value applicants for the skills they bring beyond a job description.

In this role, you'll get to:

 - Own the external surfaces. Prioritize which external tools and surfaces we build for, and define how Nova's capabilities are exposed to and consumed by external AI.

 - Own MCP Apps and tool-specific capabilities. Build the connectors, protocols, and packaging that make Nova usable from external environments

 - Decide how we deliver the best experience in each third-party tool, and partner with design on UX.

 - Partner closely with your engineering team to launch impactful projects, and with the Agent Platform team on the architecture your surfaces run on

 - Research industry trends across the agentic ecosystem to identify new surfaces and opportunities

 - Engage with customers regularly (e.g. user testing, discovery, research, roadmap sharing) to understand how they work in their own AI tools

 - Create adoption plans and measure ongoing engagement with the surfaces you ship

We are looking for people who have:

 - Experience working on a SaaS product (B2B, B2B2C)

 - Deep customer empathy

 - Hands-on experience building AI products, especially for enterprise customers

 - Technical understanding of agent architectures, APIs, and protocols (e.g. MCP), and the ability to partner deeply with engineering on connectors, auth, and integration work

 - Sound product judgment on when to standardize versus diverge across surfaces and personas

 - Thrive on solving complex technical problems and partnering cross-functionally to translate stakeholder needs into product architecture

 - Strong analytical skills, and the ability to leverage data, research, and market analysis to inform product decisions and strategy

 - Experience working with agile engineering teams and tools like Jira

 - Collaborative team player, comfortable partnering with a distributed team across time zones

 - Bonus points: a passion for MarTech and helping marketers succeed

What we offer:

 - Competitive salaries & meaningful equity

 - Private Medical Insurance

 - Life/Risk Assurance

 - Meal Allowance: 8.55€ per day

 - Community Days (days for us to give back to the community) 

 - Paid Annual Leave (22 days)

 - Global Lifestyle Reimbursement Account

 - Paid Sabbatical

 - Complete laptop workstation

The base salary range for this position in Lisbon, Portugal, is €49,000 – €61,000 per year (gross). This range is provided in anticipation of the requirements of the EU Pay Transparency Directive (2023/970), which EU member states are implementing into national law, and reflects the expected compensation at the start of employment for this role. The final offer will be determined by your experience, qualifications, and performance throughout the selection process, while ensuring alignment with our internal equity principles.
